correctness.rationale: For E=e2,S=e1, derivative D_i=E+S x_i+x_i² makes singular coordinate values roots of common quadratic. Two-value multiplicities r,s give restrictions modulo four via binomial mod2; n≡2 mod4 admits exactly 1+1 block lines, other cases binary points |I|≡1 mod4. Polar ranks of quadratic tangent forms determine ordinary nodes and transverse nondegeneracy; diagonal translation invariance yields exact e3 homogeneous cubic germ mult3. Singular locus dimension≤1, ambient dimension n-2≥2, implies regular in codim1; hypersurface CM and irreducibility argument gives normality. Independent complete F4 projective enumeration gives n4..7 singular counts 4,6,25,28, exactly matching predicted sets.

originality.rationale: Cafure–Matera–Privitelli Theorem3.1 already gives at most d-1 distinct coordinate values for symmetric hypersurfaces; d=3 gives two-value restriction. It does not determine the exact char2 residue pattern, components, intersections or tangent cones. Cayley cubic n=4 ordinary nodes classical.

Complete F4 counts n4..7 are finite corroboration, not the all-n proof.
